request: Insert screws to both holes to be able to fix tool on the table

actions.relational_constraint: Place one screw in each hole.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the two referenced holes in the CAD model; screw type and dimensions are not specified.
steps: Localize the action to mounting-base section R01. The referenced pair is feature group FG01, consisting of right-end mounting hole F002 and left-end mounting hole F003; these are the only two equal through holes whose stated function is to receive mounting fasteners and secure the bracket to an external support.

Use cylindrical bore wall FACE 0 to establish the first screw axis at CAD X=153 mm and Z=-30 mm, and use cylindrical bore wall FACE 1 to establish the second screw axis at CAD X=15 mm and Z=-30 mm. Both bore axes are parallel to CAD Y and pass through the base from Y=15 mm to Y=0 mm.

Use FACE 57, the upper base support plane at CAD Y=15 mm, as the screw-head seating side. Use FACE 59, the bottom mounting face at CAD Y=0 mm, as the table-contact side. Orient both screws from the upper side toward the table in the CAD -Y direction.

Create a new parameterized screw component as a separate solid rather than fusing it to the bracket. Define its shank diameter, head style, head diameter, head height, overall length, thread specification, and table engagement length as parameters because these values are not supplied by the request.

Select a screw shank diameter that provides suitable clearance within the existing 15 mm diameter bores. Do not resize, countersink, counterbore, or thread F002 or F003 unless a specific screw standard is later provided.

Model the screw shank as a cylinder coaxial with CAD Y. Set the length to pass through the 15 mm base thickness and provide the required engagement below FACE 59 into the table or a corresponding nut. If detailed threads are required, add a helical thread compatible with the selected table insert or nut; otherwise use a simplified nominal shank for assembly representation.

Sketch the selected screw-head profile on a plane normal to CAD Y and create the head by extrusion or revolution. Position the underside of the head against FACE 57. Add standard head-edge chamfers or fillets and the selected drive recess only after the screw standard is defined.

Place the first screw instance coaxially within F002 using FACE 0 and center coordinates X=153 mm, Z=-30 mm. Constrain the underside of its head to FACE 57 and direct its shank through the base toward and beyond FACE 59.
Duplicate or instance the same screw for F003, preserving identical dimensions and orientation. Constrain it coaxially to FACE 1 at X=15 mm, Z=-30 mm and seat its head on FACE 57.
Keep both screws as separate assembly components so they can be inserted, removed, or replaced. Do not alter the connected bracket solid SOLID 0 for this insertion operation.

Run interference and clearance checks between each screw shank and bore walls FACE 0 and FACE 1, between both screw heads and the surrounding area of FACE 57, and between the projected screw lengths and the intended table structure.

Verify that both heads bear fully on FACE 57, the bracket underside FACE 59 can remain flush against the table, and sufficient thread engagement exists below FACE 59. Finalize the screw standard and length only after the table thickness, table-hole or insert specification, and required preload are known.

intention: Enable the tool to be fixed on the table.
